commit.message:
Fourth result: the last comparator verdicts on Linux

Changes README.md, VERIFY.md, RELATED-WORK.md and notes/e8-results.json:

- The comparator accepted the third result (comparator/UniformFourier.json)
  in a tree compiled from nothing, at the third attempt.
- It accepted the two configurations of pull request #2, by Chafik Boukhalfa,
  for which he reports his own runs with the real sandbox.
- Each of these runs had a stand-in for the comparator's sandbox; no run
  here used the real one.
- Wording about the Linux runs made exact after an audit of the logs: the
  memory convention, and "Replayed lines" in place of "modules replayed".

No Lean file, tool or certificate is changed. MANIFEST.sha256 re-made.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
